subject.title: chore(deps): bump the android-deps group across 1 directory with 2 updates

question: Should the Android owner accept the Kotlin 2.4.10 compiler/Compose upgrade after Dependabot refreshes the branch against current main?
rationale: The patch has no concrete line-level defect and the supplied Android CI lanes pass, but adopting a compiler and Compose-plugin release is an owner acceptance decision that automation cannot make safely.

options.title: Refresh and merge
options.body: Let Dependabot rebase, recheck the Android gates on that exact head, then merge the shared catalog upgrade.

options.title: Defer the compiler upgrade
options.body: Keep Kotlin 2.4.0 for now if the Android owner wants a separately planned compatibility evaluation.

recommendation.title: Refresh and merge
